episodes.title: Calling
episodes.summary: Ayrton Senna begins his racing career in Formula Ford. Far from home and dreaming big, he craves recognition and more opportunities on the track.

episodes.title: Belonging
episodes.summary: After catching Peter Warr's eye, Senna makes a decisive career move. A trip to Italy elevates his car's performance. Alain Prost and Senna cross paths.

episodes.title: Ambition
episodes.summary: Galvão discusses Senna's duty to Brazil. A karaoke night opens doors. Ayrton's rivalry with Prost intensifies before the 1988 World Championship.

episodes.title: Passion
episodes.summary: Senna's romance with Xuxa sparks a media frenzy. A broken engine, public conflicts and on-track drama escalate the tensions between Senna and Prost.

episodes.title: Hero
episodes.summary: After Senna's controversial press conference, Balestre announces the season's drivers. Prost leaves McLaren, and Senna makes a desperate move to win.

episodes.title: Time
episodes.summary: Senna makes a pivotal career move. As friends suffer track accidents, he pushes for increased safety measures before his fateful race at Imola.
